migration.latest_experiment_note: Both seeded-cache candidates rejected: hit-return four-worker ratios 0.953915x / 0.987303x; dense index has mixed 1/2-worker results. All 126 processes match; all 510 baseline input bytes restored. Java performance goal remains open.
migration.persistence: Production BCC v6 edit observed in native-decoded terrain after restart; saved bytes unchanged.

admission.scope: Canonical BCC data, retained futures/cache, saved neighbours, stored lighting and restart. Imported history remains Partial with zero attempts; full world registration remains open.

gameplay.scope: Tick-owned creative full-cube break/place, unpatched hotbar, current viewers, dirty BCC saves and restart. Full physics, poses, menus, survival and light/ticket lifecycle remain open; socket tests are not GUI proof.

pillars.scope: Tick-owned axis-only creative full-cube placement/break, all six native faces, current viewers, negative/chunk-border coordinates, retained holders and dirty BCC save/restart. Native state selection/codecs; full useOn, neighbour callbacks, physics, menus, survival and GUI remain open.

flight.scope: Synthetic TCP flight on frozen BCore revisions: motion-directed admission improves delivered terrain ahead, with a slightly higher ping p95. Lead is sampled in 8-block steps and capped at 136; uniform view readiness, GUI smoothness and matched Java flight remain open. Generation and registry source bytes are unchanged.

runtime.scope: BCore before/after: lower tail latency with deferred owner work, async durable saves and client-paced chunks. Correction median rose from 93 to 125 ms and fewer chunks were delivered. Java superiority, complete gameplay and GUI rendering remain separate open checks.

checkpoint.tests_note: October 8 workspace run reused on unchanged Rust sources; October 10 adds a same-binary desert-well replay.

parity.scope: 2026-10-02 release snapshot, four Rayon workers, one shared generation context per captured region; seed 846692123413862008, three 16×16 Overworld regions, Y=-64..319. Exact-state match is 600 lower than the historical checkpoint. Includes air; not a completion percentage. Executable/capture provenance and source coverage are in the parity report.
parity.components: 895 numeric cases / 62649 exact values; 1431 native carver cases; 688 extra-tree cases; 655 fallen-tree cases; original/trail/trial jigsaws; 13932 biome/feature memberships; 80 decorated-pot cases; 107 scattered piece saves; 10212 stair and 9360 bamboo callbacks; 76 fossil cases; 137 desert-pyramid placement passes; desert-well component cases with a real original-server witness; 39 deferred-BE cases / 55 save-read cycles; 456 native saved-mob LOAD/pairing cases across 19 CREATURE kinds; real LIGHT stages and 19 native light-packet cases
parity.coverage: Overworld only. Shared generation through SPAWN, pending/materialized typed NBT and matched-history replay are integrated. Ticket-driven FULL conversion, WG retirement, remaining structure families, persistent holders, fluid/gameplay ticks and Nether/End are incomplete. SPAWN accepts explicit world inputs; live server clock/settings updates remain pending. The NOISE material-fill kernel remains about 4.6x slower than measured Vanilla at four workers under noise-fill-wg-v2, with identical kernel fingerprints.
